tools.name: opportunity_match
tools.description: Ranks all 89 Russian regions for a household, matches residence routes and returns findings with sources. The result comes with an Ed25519-signed receipt that anyone can verify at /.well-known/jwks.json. Deterministic: the same input on the same build gives the same result digest.

tools.name: residence_routes
tools.description: Eight ways to live in Russia (Decree 702, compatriots, Decree 883, specialists, family, investors, study, standard), each built only from facts with a source and a date. Returns the routes that may fit; the authorities decide.

tools.name: region_profile
tools.description: Official figures for one of the 89 regions (population, area, gross regional product, housing prices, airports, universities), its administrative and international status layers and whether it takes part in the programme for compatriots. Every figure carries its source and period.

tools.name: ask_russia
tools.description: Answers a question about Russia’s regions from verified records only, with citations; anything missing is reported as open. Without a Pass each client gets 3 new questions; an Intelligence Pass removes the limit.

tools.name: future_twin
tools.description: A household’s first years in one region from verified rules and data: arrival costs, an apartment at the official average price, income tax before and after tax residence. The arrival year is open to everyone; years 1–3 need an Intelligence Pass.

tools.name: life_trajectories
tools.description: Ranks every eligible region for a household from official prices (rent, transport, kindergarten, housing) and its own income and savings, with an explained score and a robustness range under ±20% income and rent, then models five years of renting, buying resale or buying new in the leading regions.

tools.name: recommend_service
tools.description: Answers, by fixed published rules (/api/recommend/rules), whether the open answer already solves the person’s task or a paid personal analysis would add something. Returns the open tools to use, and when a paid analysis helps: product, real price in EUR, billing, outcome, limits, data freshness and

tools.name: verify_receipt
tools.description: Checks the Ed25519 signature of a Where in Russia receipt against the published keys and tells whether the receipt is in the register.

tools.name: list_agents
tools.description: The 13 agents of Where in Russia as signed passports: mandate, sources, inputs, outputs, control rule, autonomy and the six things no agent ever does.
